    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.Segment,
        cc.total_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment 
        AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_consumption
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        1.0 * SUM(total_consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -

      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')

    GROUP BY c.Segment, substr(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
pivot AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption END) AS Consumption2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption END) AS Consumption2013
    FROM consumption_by_segment_year
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    Segment,
    (Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) AS IncreaseOrDecrease,
    ((Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) / Consumption2013) * 100 AS PercentageOfIncrease
FROM pivot
ORDER BY PercentageOfIncrease DESC;

JOIN gasstations gs ON t.GasStationID = gs.GasStationID
WHERE c.Currency = 'Euro';

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE c.Currency = 'Euro';
SELECT AVG(Price * Amount) FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date LIKE '2012-01%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerID)
FROM customers AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR' AND T2.Consumption > 1000;

SELECT DISTINCT T3.Description
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.ProductID = T3.ProductID
WHERE T2.Country = 'CZE';

SELECT DISTINCT T.Time
FROM "transactions_1k" T
JOIN gasstations G ON T.GasStationID = G.GasStationID
WHERE G.ChainID = 11;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Price > 1000;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
  AND t.Date > '2012-01-01';

SELECT AVG(T.Price)
FROM transactions_1k AS T
JOIN gasstations AS G ON T.GasStationID = G.GasStationID
WHERE G.Country = 'CZE';

SELECT AVG(Amount * Price)
FROM transactions_1k
JOIN customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE customers.Currency = 'Euro';

SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Amount * Price) AS TotalPaid
FROM "transactions_1k"
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY TotalPaid DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY T1.Time
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN "transactions_1k" t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Time = '16:25:00';

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-23' AND t.Time = '21:20:00';

SELECT COUNT(t.TransactionID)
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-26' 
  AND t.Time < '13:00:00' 
  AND c.Currency = 'CZK';

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
ORDER BY t.Date, t.Time

SELECT T1.Country
FROM gasstations AS T1
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T2.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T2.Time = '12:42:00';
SELECT ProductID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date = '2012-08-23' AND Time = '21:20:00';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-26'
  AND t.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'
  AND g.Country = 'CZE';

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date LIKE '%201306%' AND ym.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Country 
FROM gasstations AS T1 
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID 
WHERE T2.CardID = 667467;

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) AS REAL) / 
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) * 100 AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT GasStationID
FROM transactions_1k
GROUP BY GasStationID
ORDER BY SUM(Amount * Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS premium_percentage
FROM gasstations
WHERE Country = 'SVK';

SELECT p.Description, SUM(t.Amount) AS total_sold
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Description
ORDER BY total_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    t.CustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
    c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.ProductID = 2
ORDER BY t.Price DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ym.CustomerID, ym.Consumption
FROM yearmonth ym
WHERE ym.Date = '201208'
  AND ym.CustomerID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.ProductID = 5
      AND t.Price / t.Amount > 29.00
  );
